sql:
SELECT
  EXTRACT(HOUR FROM o.placed_at)::int AS hour,
  COUNT(*) AS total_orders_placed,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.tenant_id) AS distinct_tenants_with_orders,
  ROUND(SUM(o.grand_total / er.rate)) AS total_revenue_eur
FROM orders o
JOIN exchange_rates er
  ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
  AND er.quote_code = o.currency_code
  AND er.as_of = DATE '2025-11-28'
WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-28 00:00:00'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-11-29 00:00:00'
GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM o.placed_at)
ORDER BY hour ASC

  AND er.quote_code = o.currency_code

GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM o.placed_at)
ORDER BY hour ASC
note: Converted each order's grand_total to EUR by dividing by the EUR→order-currency exchange_rates.rate on 2025-11-28 (since rate is quoted as currency units per 1 EUR), then summed and rounded per hour. Hours with zero orders (if any) will not appear as rows since this is a GROUP BY over actual order placements.
